tools.name: word.info
tools.description: Inspect a document in your workspace (docx, md, html, rtf, odt, txt or json): pages, words, paragraphs, sections, comments and document properties. Reads only. `path` is relative to your workspace, the folder your own file tools (list_dir, read_file) see; files outside it cannot be named.

tools.name: word.run
tools.description: Run up to 64 commands from the word engine's catalog, in order, on the document at `path` in your workspace, or on a new empty document, then write it as docx, md, html, rtf, odt, txt, json, pdf or png (by `format` or the extension of `out`) to `out` when given. Each command is {id, params}. Only reviewed commands run: those the skill's commands.md lists untagged (work inside the document), and picture inserts that read an image from your workspace; anything that reaches other files, code, the network, devices or the app is refused before any command runs. Paths are relative to your workspace, and `out` must be a new file. Read the word-engine skill first.
